The build wrapper's Finalize step runs `aether ceremony closeout --workflow build` (.claude/commands/ant/build.md:393). That command, for workflow=="build", loads colony state, filters active PendingSuggestions and sets `pending_suggestions_block` (cmd/ceremony_cmd.go:246-249). Build is not handled by closeoutDirectVisual (cmd/closeout_direct_render.go:22-31 handles only continue/plan/seal), so it falls to renderCeremonyCloseoutVisual, which prints a "Suggestions From This Build" stage containing renderPendingSuggestionsBlock output (cmd/ceremony_cmd.go:620-627, 681-696): each suggestion's type, full content, reason, ID, and the exact `aether suggest-approve --approve/--dismiss <id>` commands. That is delivered content, not a pointer. The cited cmd/codex_build_finalize.go:863-870 is only the JSON result of build-finalize, not the user-facing closeout. What remains true: the build wrapper's "After the Build" stage (.claude/commands/ant/build.md:411-424) offers no AskUserQuestion option to approve/dismiss suggestions; the interactive tick-to-approve prompt happens only in continue.md:243-249. So the interactive approval step moved from build to continue, while the suggestions themselves are fully presented (with copyable approve commands) at build closeout.
